## Die wichtigste neue Regel

Grad ist **nicht frei einschiebbar**. Alle fünf getesteten Gradlöschungen sind
belegt, sechs von zehn Gradwechseln sind belegt, aber keine der sechs freien
Gradeinfügungen in bislang ungradierte Anker kommt vor. Der bessere
Werkstattmechanismus lautet daher:

> Eine bereits lizenzierte Gradschublade kann E, EE, EEE oder keinen Grad
> tragen; der Schreiber darf die Schublade nicht beliebig hinter jedem
> Handlungskopf erfinden.

Das ist wichtig für neue Seiten: ein sichtbares E/EE/EEE wird nur dann als Grad
gelesen, wenn die umgebende Rezeptfamilie die Gradstelle schon lizenziert.

## Abschluss von Schritt oder Aussage

Der bessere Default lautet jetzt präzise:

```text
DY = den aktuellen Schritt abschließen
am Aussageende: zugleich die Aussage abschließen
im Aussageinneren: lokaler Schrittabschluss, danach weiter
```

Die drei internen Rezepte sind jeweils einmalig:

- `Y+DY+D_LABEL` auf f1r schließt einen Postenschritt vor einer lokalen
  Kennung; danach folgen noch 26 Karten;
- `D_ADDR+O+DY+D_LABEL` auf f55v schließt einen Ausführungsschritt vor einer
  lokalen Kennung; drei Karten später endet die Aussage mit einem zweiten
  `DY`;
- `OK+EE+DY+OL` auf f75r sagt sichtbar „setzen, Grad II, abschließen,
  fortsetzen“; drei Karten später folgt wiederum der Aussageabschluss.

Gerade `DY+OL` ist semantisch nützlich: „abschließen“ und „fortsetzen“ sind
nicht widersprüchlich, wenn das erste den lokalen Schritt und das zweite den
laufenden Satz betrifft.

Compare `DY` with `OL`, `OT`, grade markers, execution `O` and `DA` on the same

## Decision rule and claim ceiling

Pass as a positional working audit if all 5,122 events and 793 statements join
exactly, every `DY` is counted once, its within-recipe position and successor
scope are explicit, and the old/current cohorts agree on the same classification
rules. The outcome may refine the editorial scope of “close” but may not change
the root value, recipe, statement boundary or German clause.

## Frozen primary tests

1. Enumerate all cross-array same-Kluge-member label pairs. A productive
   homolog transform requires at least two disjoint physical-folio pairs; A09
   alone fails it.
2. In the admitted running cache, require at least 20 exact stems possessing
   both `l` and `m` endings and at least 100 occurrences of each ending. A
   stem must contain at least one sign before the ending; bare `l`/`m` tokens
   are ineligible for the paired-stem model.
3. Under exact conditioning by stem, terminal `m` must have a multi-token
   physical-line-final odds ratio above 5 and one-sided `p < .001`.
4. The direction must remain above OR 3 and `p < .01` under
   stem×section×language×hand and stem×page conditioning and every
   leave-one-section-out analysis with estimable variance.
5. An obligatory allograph is rejected if either at least ten paired `m`
   occurrences are nonfinal or at least ten paired `l` occurrences are final.
6. A free semantic suffix is not selected without an independent repeated
   image or record-state contrast after physical line position is controlled.

## Why record and panel value remain open

All ten joined paragraph-close targets and all nine joined legacy-statement
close targets are themselves line-final. Across thirteen records and ten
panels, only one unique joined endpoint exists: f83r.55 `cthal`, ending in `l`.
There is no `m` record/panel endpoint and no internal direct target endpoint.
All four **direct-join** increment gates therefore stop before scoring. This is
non-identifiability, not evidence that higher structure has no effect.

The wider frozen-stem projection supplies exactly one scoreable sensitivity:
fourteen legacy-statement endpoints include six `m`, eight `l` and one
physical-line-internal `l`. Its stem×line-position estimate is OR
1.1 with

draft_decisions.reason: GDT419 explicitly proposes licensed grade slots and GDT420 already distinguishes open from blocked cells. Held-family verification is a future test of this existing restriction, not a newly proposed mechanism. IDEA48 relative versus absolute comparison is a different question.

GDT556 explicitly states local-step closure with continuing statement, and GDT557 composes DY+OL accordingly. The current scope_for labels depend only on position within inherited statements. This does not provide independently observed continuation of an action or semantic scope.

The proposed source-member-conditioned rule does not specify independently observable membership or why the two members require opposite endings. GDT800 already tests homolog coverage and leaves A09 direction open; GDT801 does not bind a terminal label meaning. No new packet or discriminating status mapping is supplied. This is not a rejection of a future explicit conditional model.

idea16.unit_gap: GDT556 counts analyst DY atoms inside recipes; IDEA16 asks for a candidate complete closure whole. No selection of complete raw wholes is specified.
idea16.endpoint_gap: Inherited statement end is fixed by source editions. The three internal DY examples were assigned local-step closure by position, not independent action-release annotation.
idea16.logical_limit: A result/material carrier need not predict unchanged subsequent action rates in general. A contrast can compare explicitly fixed statistical models, but cannot refute the entire semantic category.
idea16.decision: Retain conditional not-tested method question; preserve original five-folio,80-percent and20-point conditions if the original test is selected. No new manuscript evidence.
